## Summary

I've resolved ticket T-3002. The issue was that the doc-embedder pod had a nodeSelector for GPU nodes but was missing a toleration for the `dedicated: gpu` taint applied to those nodes. The scheduler couldn't place the pod because it didn't tolerate all the taints on the GPU nodes. The fix is to add the missing toleration to the Deployment's pod spec, which will allow it to be scheduled alongside the ml-serving team's pods that are already running there.
